content: Zain Ali is a Software Engineer and Full Stack .NET Developer with 5 years of software development experience. His work spans enterprise applications, financial technology, payment and banking integrations, REST APIs, production support, and AI-powered applications.

Zain works as a Full Stack Developer at Juba Express from February 2025 to the present. He develops and maintains enterprise FinTech payment and remittance applications and contributes across application screens, backend services, APIs, data, and deployments.

At Juba Express, Zain has developed RESTful APIs for payment, remittance, and banking services, integrated a Mastercard Payment Gateway, and worked with multiple banking APIs and money-transfer systems. He optimizes SQL queries and backend services and participates in code reviews.

Zain's Juba Express responsibilities include investigating production issues, application bugs, and performance bottlenecks; supporting clients; performing root-cause analysis; managing deployments; and validating releases after deployment. His portfolio does not include confidential transaction data, credentials, or internal production details.

Zain worked as a Software Engineer at IBEX Global PVT from March 2023 to January 2025. He built and maintained enterprise applications using ASP.NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, and MongoDB, including scalable REST APIs, backend services, dashboards, reports, and real-time analytics.

At IBEX Global, Zain worked on AI-powered customer-support solutions, Agentic AI, Azure OpenAI and GPT integrations, chat bots, voice bots, Salesforce integrations, enterprise APIs, authentication, and workflow automation. He also worked with Node.js, Express.js, WebSockets, and JWT authentication for real-time messaging.

Zain was a .NET Core Developer at Technomites from January 2022 to February 2023. His work included ASP.NET Core MVC, ASP.NET Web APIs, Angular, jQuery, AJAX, SQL Server, MongoDB, payment gateway integrations, microservices, backend and frontend development, troubleshooting, and application stability.

Zain was a Junior .NET Developer at BDO Pakistan from June 2021 to January 2022. He worked on ASP.NET MVC web applications, SQL Server, backend development, application testing, performance optimization, technical support, AJAX, and jQuery DataTables.

Zain's backend skills include C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core MVC, Web API, Entity Framework Core, Dapper, ADO.NET, microservices, REST APIs, SOAP, SignalR, Node.js, and Express.js. His primary expertise is in the .NET and C# ecosystem.
Zain's frontend skills include Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, and Bootstrap. He has full-stack experience connecting frontend workflows with REST APIs and backend services.

Zain has worked with SQL Server, MongoDB, and MySQL. His experience includes database query optimization, data retrieval and aggregation, reporting, and backend data access using Entity Framework Core, Dapper, and ADO.NET.

Zain's AI experience includes Azure OpenAI, GPT integrations, Agentic AI, AI-powered applications, customer-support automation, chat bots, voice bots, enterprise API integrations, and workflow automation.
Zain's tools and delivery experience include Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure, IIS, Jira, Postman, Swagger, Agile and Scrum collaboration, unit testing, design patterns, and code reviews.

RefleCX.io is a customer-experience platform Zain contributed to. His work included reporting functionality, large-scale data processing, real-time customer-experience insights, complex API development, data retrieval and aggregation, analytics, API performance optimization, and system scalability improvements.

IBEX Messenger is a real-time messaging and AI-powered chatbot project. Zain worked on its backend using Node.js and Express.js, WebSocket communication, RESTful APIs, JWT authentication, real-time messaging, Azure OpenAI integration, AI-powered automation, backend optimization, and database query optimization.

Zain has worked on Agentic AI customer-support solutions for chat and voice interactions. The workflows include Salesforce and enterprise API integrations, authentication, account verification, order verification and retrieval, plan information, and business workflow automation.

Juba Express is an enterprise FinTech money-transfer and payment platform. Zain contributes to RESTful APIs, payment processing, remittance services, Mastercard Payment Gateway and banking API integrations, production support, deployments, backend optimization, and SQL optimization. Confidential financial, customer, transaction, and internal production information is not part of his public portfolio.

Fougito is a restaurant and garage management system. Zain contributed to backend API and frontend development, POS integration, order management, and real-time analytics. The project launched on the web and Play Store.

Zain built a personal inventory management project using .NET Core, SQL Server, HTML, Bootstrap, and jQuery. Its features include inventory tracking, stock management, reporting, authentication, and role-based access control.
Zain completed a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BS IT) at Sindh Agriculture University from 2018 to 2022. His study focus included software architecture and project management.

Public contact details for Zain Ali: email Zain-Alii@outlook.com; LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/zain-ali-34123216a; phone +92 308 395 4055. His portfolio says he is open to meaningful full-stack opportunities, product collaborations, and complex application challenges.

Zain is a Full Stack .NET Developer with substantial backend experience in ASP.NET Core, C#, REST APIs, SQL Server, MongoDB, enterprise integrations, and backend services. He also has frontend experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap.

The current portfolio lists Azure and Azure OpenAI as cloud and AI experience. It does not list AWS or React as professional skills, and no certifications are listed. For skills or details that are not present in the current portfolio, do not assume experience.
